notes: Structural spec for the `structured` (v4) prompt's output. v4 renames v3's `Risk` finding field to `Possible impact` (neutral, matches the who/what-affected content), labels findings F1/F2 and systemic observations S1/S2 with their own headings, reorders to Questions-for-a-human before Coverage, and renames `Coverage and blind spots` -> `Coverage depth` and `Questions only a human can answer` -> `Questions for a human`. `Systemic observations` remains CONDITIONAL (only when the evidence shows a pervasive property), so it is deliberately NOT required here. Only the invariants Observation/Interpretation/Next investigation are required per finding; Oracle/Possible impact/Status stay optional. Presence/conformance check only — POST-PROCESSING, never a judgment of quality. The human is the sole judge.
